maintenance_goal: Review package lifecycle evidence before the quarterly planning window.

recurrence.rationale: Quarterly review matches the collection's release pace and evidence freshness requirement.

trigger.description: The owner starts the manual review during quarterly planning.

scheduler.executor: The collection maintainer starts the route manually.

authority.approval_system: Manual review by the collection maintainer.

route.when: The quarterly review starts with current evidence for one package.

stop.condition: Stop when the collection is retired or after four reviews without renewal.
stop.on_failure: Keep the proposal pending and report the missing evidence to the owner.

rollback.configuration: There is no scheduler entry to remove.
rollback.artifacts: The owner retains accepted review records and may discard unapproved drafts.
